analysis_scope: Read-only profiling of NVD CVE Configuration cpeMatch usage. Raw criteria strings are not treated as unique CPE identities, and no CPE Dictionary comparison or CPE matching semantics are applied.

configuration_structure.source: All configuration/node entities are expanded read-only from NvdCveRecord.configurations JSON, including entities with no flattened cpeMatch. Occurrence relationships use NvdCpeMatch.

notes: Special-token counts for '*' and '-' are reported per field; their presence is not automatically classified as malformed.
contains_escape_sequence is an observed parser-relevant form, not an error by itself.
Attention categories may overlap, so their counts are not mutually exclusive.

protected_domains: Ground Truth and its relation tables

cpe_parser.semantics: limited structural validation only; bound values remain escaped/raw and are not semantically matched

importer_behavior.configurations: original configuration array retained in NvdCveRecord.configurations JSONField
importer_behavior.match_criteria_id: required valid UUID; stored as UUIDField
importer_behavior.operators_and_negate: optional configuration/node values copied onto each flattened cpeMatch occurrence
importer_behavior.range_fields: missing key becomes NULL; present value must be a string and is preserved verbatim, including an empty string

version_range_cross_analysis.notes: Distinct criteria counts are per cell. A criteria string used both with and without range fields is counted in both cells.
